# The DRIPBaR Huebner Oaks

> The DRIPBaR Huebner Oaks is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in the Huebner Oaks area of San Antonio, Texas. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+, High Dose Vitamin C, weekly GLP-1 shots given in the clinic, medically supervised peptide therapy, VO2 Max and DNA genetic testing, lab testing, and wellness therapies (infrared sauna, red light, halotherapy, NormaTec compression, cold plunge), delivered by licensed nurses under physician oversight. Every first visit begins with a brief health screening.

Key facts:
- Address: 11255 Huebner Road, Suite 107, San Antonio, TX 78230
- Phone: call (210) 306-4135 or text (210) 934-5550
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday: 10 AM to 3 PM
- Booking: https://huebneroaks.dripbarsanantonio.com/booking (online request; the team contacts you to confirm) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $199. The Debut is $139 and 100% Hydration is $99. NAD+ IV starts at $249 and NAD+ IM shots start at $65, after a consultation. High Dose Vitamin C starts at $179 after a consultation. IM Quick Shot blends are $50. Weekly GLP-1 shots start at $25 (semaglutide) or $39 (tirzepatide) per week after a consultation. Ask about member pricing.
- New guest offer: New guests choose their experience and receive up to $100 in free perks on the first visit: a Lifestyle drip, an add-on vitamin, and an additional service.
- Memberships: Essential, Evolve, Elevate, and Elite tiers with monthly quick shots or drips and monthly credits. Call (210) 306-4135 or text (210) 934-5550 for pricing.
- All services are administered under the supervision of Dr. A.D. Thakkar, M.D. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, and NAD+.
